title: Register Keep-Back — Which Retail Receipts Are Counted
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, over-the-counter allowance — counting convention.** The register keep-back held back from a mail catalog order is set per retail receipt counted; this convention fixes which retail receipts are counted.

**Rule.** The receipts counted depend on the plan and on the latest forfeited quarter: where the plan allows 2 or more mail catalog or online orders per quarter and the latest forfeited quarter carries at least one mail catalog or online order, the retail receipts posted in the last two whole months are counted; where the plan allows 2 or more such orders per quarter and the latest forfeited quarter carries none, the retail receipts posted in the last whole month are counted; and otherwise the retail receipts tagged to the current quarter that carry a posting date are counted.

**Terms used.**
- *The plan allows* — the number of mail catalog and online orders per quarter of the member's PrairieRx plan.
- *Latest forfeited quarter* — the benefit quarter of the most recently posted forfeiture entry in the coverage's allowance activity; its mail catalog or online orders are the purchases tagged to it with one of those channels.
- *Posted in the last two whole months / the last whole month* — retail pharmacy purchases on the coverage whose posting date falls in that window, whatever quarter they are tagged to.
- *Current quarter* — the calendar quarter that contains today.

### Counting table

| Plan's mail catalog and online orders per quarter | Latest forfeited quarter carries a mail catalog or online order | Retail receipts counted |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | Yes | Those posted in the last two whole months |
| 2 or more | No | Those posted in the last whole month |
| Fewer than 2 | Yes or No | Those tagged to the current quarter that carry a posting date |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- A plan allowing 2 orders per quarter; the latest forfeited quarter had one online order; retail receipts were posted 20 days ago and 50 days ago, and none in the current quarter: both are counted under the two-month window.
- A plan allowing 1 order per quarter: only retail receipts tagged to the current quarter and carrying a posting date are counted.
